style: Premium contractor-marketing brand. Near-black stage, warm gold halo behind big League Gothic numerals, Montserrat supporting labels. Same visual system as sibling piece pricing-tiers-reveal — restrained, confident, no gimmicks. Full-frame replacement for a talking-head shot, not a corner bug.

customize.note: Hand-authored to brand-match pricing-tiers-reveal exactly (same CSS custom properties, same League Gothic tabular-nums numeral treatment, same card-glow radial halo, same proxy-tween count-up pattern). Catalog searched (`money counter with glow halo`, `number divide split into segments transition`) — apple-money-count is finance-flavored (green flash + money burst + SFX) and would break brand match; number-wheel/number-pop-in components are generic digit primitives without the halo+numeral CSS this brand needs. Reused the proven proxy-tween count-up + card-glow pattern from pricing-tiers-reveal instead of those blocks.

scenes.emotion: hook — the big, slightly intimidating goal number
scenes.motion: halo fade-in + scale_punch numeral + count_up($0→$500,000) + label_stagger(PER YEAR)

scenes.emotion: clean transform beat — reframing the annual number into monthly terms
scenes.motion: scale_punch(÷ symbol) + slide_bottom(12 MONTHS label) + stagger fill of a 12-segment tick bar (division made visible, not gimmicky)

scenes.text: $41K–$42K / PER MONTH / THAT'S JUST A FEW STRONG PROJECTS A MONTH
scenes.emotion: resolve — the real, achievable number; biggest/boldest moment, then reassurance, then freeze-hold for a clean cut back to host
scenes.motion: halo fade-in (brighter/bigger than scene-goal) + scale_punch numeral + count_up($0→$41K) + slide-in range-extension(–$42K) + glow pulse on landing + label_stagger(PER MONTH) + fade_in(closing reassurance line) + hold
